input_isolation: Fresh agents received prompt-only JSON and raw fixtures, without rubrics or prior answers. Cases were batched within agents, not each in a separate model process.
revision_scope: First 16 cases ran on the working candidate before the final literal-path instruction and attribution-only note. The path case ran after that behavioral fix. Exact per-agent read snapshot was not captured; the final package hashes below identify the review candidate, not a retroactive exact snapshot for every run.
archive_transform: Answer prose unchanged; line endings normalized to LF. Local absolute sandbox image targets replaced with the corresponding repository synthetic SVG for public portability/privacy. Raw originals and traces remain in ignored local/eval-outputs. No real paper assets are archived.
limitations: Single runs, no baseline comparison or accuracy estimate.
Two illustrated cases have unobserved final-host rendering; they are partial rather than full delivery passes.
Illustrated followup is a prompt-supplied previous preference, not a measured multi-session memory test.
